sources.name: NamuWiki Arcade/Singapore (오락실/싱가포르)
sources.example_data_quote: Cow Play Cow Moo Downtown East: address 1 Pasir Ris Cl #04-102; hours Mon-Thu 11:00-23:00 Fri 11:00-01:00; IIDX 33 Sparkle Shower 1 regular (Premium Free 2 medals), CHUNITHM X-VERSE 1 unit (3 medals), maimai DX PRiSM 1 unit (4 medals), SDVX Navla 1 Valkyrie + 1 regular, Taiko NIJIIRO 1, DDR WORLD, GITADORA, DRS, Pop'n, Nostalgia, Reflec Beat with per-mode prices and cab condition notes.
sources.adds_over_current: Compared CPCM Downtown East, CPCM Suntec, Timezone Causeway Point in arcades.json: game titles largely already present via allnet/ziv (e.g. Downtown East already has chunithm/ddr/drs/gitadora/iidx/maimai_dx/nostalgia/popn/reflec/sdvx/taiko). Major gap filled is empty cabs[] / sparse cab_models: wiki gives per-title unit counts, medal/token prices, version names (e.g. IIDX 33 Sparkle Shower, maimai DX PRiSM PLUS), and condition notes (broken screens, off machines). Hillion: map has maimai_dx+sdvx; wiki confirms 2x maimai DX PRiSM PLUS and pricing. Closest SEA analogue to hkarcade.fandom for cab-level detail, but Singapore-only (~18 live venues documented; closed section also tracked).
sources.note: Last modified 2026-07-10 on page. Korean original at namu.wiki same path. Structured by chain (CPCM, Paco Funworld, Timezone, Virtualand, Zone X) with network service badges (e-amuse/Aime/etc). HTML tables scrapeable. No equivalent NamuWiki pages found for Malaysia/Thailand/Indonesia/Philippines.

Game fill for PH still depends on ALL.Net (e.g. maimai DX IV shows 47 PH locations including QUANTUM SM STA.MESA / SM NORTH EDSA) which is already in pipeline. Priority: venue existence + address hygiene, not cab lists.
sources.note: Largest official multi-venue SEA chain locator verified. Amenity tags are coarse (Arcade/VR), not title-level.

summary: Searched English + local terms (เกมเซ็นเตอร์/ตู้เกม Thailand, daftar arcade Indonesia, 오락실 Singapore/Malaysia on NamuWiki, maimai/chunithm venue lists, chain locators). SEA currently ~1122 map venues / 368 other-only (PH 206, MY 69, TH 48, ID 30, VN 7, SG 8 claw-only stubs). ONLY Singapore has a maintained enthusiast wiki with full per-cab lineups (NamuWiki Arcade/Singapore), comparable in spirit to hkarcade.fandom though smaller. Everywhere else, verified finds are official chain store locators (Timezone SG/PH/ID, CPCM SG, AEON Fantasy MY) that give addresses/hours and coarse amenity tags, not music-game cabinet lists. Rhythm titles for international Sega cabinets remain best covered by ALL.Net location search already in the pipeline (confirmed live today: maimai DX IV 32 SG / 47 PH locations). No dedicated multi-venue cab wiki/spreadsheet/map was verified for Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia, Brunei, Myanmar, or Laos. Facebook MaiMaiAsia references a global OneDrive maimai spreadsheet (2024 post) but the sheet is login-walled and could not be opened. Echo Games Thailand claims ~80 music-game locations on Instagram but has no public structured venue database. Funworld Indonesia (~200 FECs) store-location page is JS-empty. Playerbox Thailand venues page is JS-empty. No Cambodia/Brunei/Myanmar/Laos sources found beyond generic tourism pages.
dead_ends: ALL.Net / e-amusement / ZIv / WAHLAP / BemaniCN / Round1 USA (already pipeline, excluded as 'finds'). MaiMaiAsia OneDrive global excel (1drv.ms link redirects to Microsoft login; unverified). insert-coin.app (SPA, no static content for SEA venues). funworld.id/store-location (live site shell, no venue HTML). playerbox.co/venues (live shell, no venue HTML). chunimai.net (tournament site only, not a venue DB). Echo Games Thailand Instagram/Facebook (operator, multi-branch, no scrapeable multi-venue cab list). Quantum Amusement PH social posts (branch name drops only). Tom's World PH / World of Fun PH (no verified public multi-venue store map with games). Thai-language searches for รายชื่อตู้เกม/แผนที่เกมเซ็นเตอร์ yielded social/one-off content only. Vietnamese 'địa điểm maimai/chunithm' and Indonesian 'daftar tempat maimai' yielded no maintained database. NamuWiki foreign arcade pages: Singapore and Greater China/USA/Japan/Australia only; no MY/TH/ID/PH pages. Google Maps/Yelp/TripAdvisor excluded as data sources per brief.
